models_evaluated: AI-CDSS using mass spectrometry data to predict antibiotic resistance

links.outcome: 14-day mortality in AI-CDSS versus standard practice in randomized trial
links.effect: Mortality lower in AI-CDSS group (92/800, 11.5%) than control (121/800, 15.1%), p = 0.03.
links.quote: Mortality was lower in the AI-CDSS group (92/800, 11.5%) than in the control group (121/800, 15.1%) (p = 0.03).

screen.reason: Randomized controlled trial evaluating the deployment of an AI-based clinical decision support system for antimicrobial resistance prediction versus standard care on patient mortality and clinician prescribing.
